changes.title: Sound mix
items: A mixing pass on the sound: creatures' voices, her "ouch!", being knocked back, a soundsystem lost and a legend's charge are easier to hear over the music; home's meadow a little fuller; a relic's chime and her knockdown cry a touch softer

changes.title: Witch variety
items: The party witches are all different now: each is a new witch from the witch generator, with bigger brims, longer cloaks and things both witchy and modern (a cat, crow, toad or bat riding along, a lantern, a potion, a spellbook, round shades, wristbands, bum bags, chunky trainers)

changes.title: Treehouse north
items: The treehouse now stands due north of the dancefloor, just outside its ring of speakers, facing the floor
At the start the ley line runs from the treehouse's front straight south across the dancefloor, then curves off to the first soundsystem
